Source: Analects 13.18, trans. James Legge, Chinese Text Project. Legge's full translation is also at The Internet Classics Archive (MIT).

See also: Mark Csikszentmihalyi, "Confucius", The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, which uses this passage to illustrate the conflict between filial piety and public duty.
